title: Client limit file (Finspot OMS)
purpose: Trading limit per client before the market opens, and limit changes during the day. Finspot's RMS limit upload (RMS_Limit-FINSPOT_Format_1) has 54 columns; the file SharePro sends Finspot daily carries only the first five (account, exchange, segment, product, collateral/margin value), so Ledgerline writes those five. A blank exchange, segment or product means across all of them.

columns.name: AccountId
columns.note: Client code (10 characters at most), or the branch ID for branch limits

columns.name: CollateralMarginValue
columns.note: Available margin/cash for the client (rupees, 2 decimals)

linked: Front office → BOD limit file (Finspot); Receipts & payouts → pay-out holds (limit changes)
source: Finspot: RMS_Limit-FINSPOT_Format_1.xlsx (54-column RMS limit upload, columns 1-5 used); SharePro's FINSPOT_RMS_LIMIT files (title line 'RMS Limits', pipe-delimited, 5 fields)
